attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across the RHEL 9 cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only async standbys built via pg_basebackup with generated SCRAM credentials. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol (standbys first, primary last) with changed boot-time proof and confirmed full replication recovery and data continuity after each restart.
